# Hyper-parameter tuning (auto-generated by `tune.py`)

Generated: 2026-11-25 02:50

Method: leave-one-capture-out cross-validation on the 7786-packet training pool (9 captures). Score = mean recall on held-out attack captures minus mean false-alarm rate on held-out normal captures (per-capture, then averaged). The unseen hold-out capture is **not** used. A setting is only changed if a candidate beats it by more than 0.005.
